HINT_RIPPS2_LIST_CFG_TEXT: The game's Title and Description from its CFG beside the game list. Theme: as the theme has them (RIPPS2's own theme leaves them off). The info page keeps them either way.
HINT_RIPPS2_PS1_PREFER: A PS1 game that is both a POPSTARTER VCD and an Ember image. Both: two rows. Ember: the Ember one only. POPSTARTER: the VCD only. The same title, a leading disc ID aside, is the same game.
HINT_RIPPS2_MY_PADS: The .pad profiles in the PADS folder beside RIPPS2: one text file a USB pad, named by its ID (2563_0575.pad), and each one checked. RIPPS2 leads the format; PADEMU reads them in a later build.
HINT_BOOT_SND: The boot sound as RIPPS2 starts. On: from the AUDIO folder, once its drive is up. On (fast): a copy beside RIPPS2 on the memory card it starts from (offered when you pick it), played as the pillars rise. It plays with Sound Effects off too.
